name: The Nature Of Man
overview: Scripture reveals that man was originally created in the image of God, reflecting His nature as both male and female (Genesis 1:27). However, the fallen human heart is described as deeply corrupt and deceitful, with every thought inclined toward evil continually (Genesis 6:5; Jeremiah 17:9). All mankind is unrighteous by nature (Romans 3:10), yet through Christ, believers are united with Him in His death, breaking the power of sin over their lives (Romans 6:6). True worship of God is spiritual and sincere, reflecting the divine nature of God as Spirit (John 4:24).
